messages:
deploy-bot: queued rollout for feature flag 'model-routing-parity' on service `inference-router` in us-west-2. plan: enable 2% -> 10% -> 50% across 30m windows; pin new runtime v2.3.1 for parity cohorts. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-parity

alex: starting the first 2% now. quiet window active 00:00-04:00. will watch latency and 5xx for the next 10m.

mia: copying monitoring checklist: latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, queue depth, gpu-mem spikes. alert thresholds set.

sam: rolling the flag using the deploy service. command:```
ffctl toggle --flag model-routing-parity --env prod --percent 2 --note "canary: 2%"
```

ops-bot: healthcheck: ingress OK, pods ok (12/12), no OOMs. telemetry stream: https://obs.internal/d/abc123

alex: confirmed 2% probe traffic routed. p50 stable, p95 +40ms (within gate). no errors so far. holding 10m. :thumbsup:

mia: minor spike in queue depth at t+6m, still below threshold. keeping watch.

deploy-bot: auto-step -> advancing to 10% in 5m if no regressions.

lara: quick note — we pinned a small subset of internal partners to v2.3.1; their cohorts are excluded from automatic unpin until soak passes. that avoids oscillation for critical customers.

sam: advancing now ->```
ffctl toggle --flag model-routing-parity --env prod --percent 10 --note "step to 10%"
```

ops-bot: telemetry: p95 stabilized, 5xx rate 0.12% (baseline 0.05%). small uptick but under emergency threshold of 0.5%. raising a minor alert for visibility (info).

alex: decision time: keep ramping or hold? i propose hold at 10% for a full 30m so we can correlate bulk metrics.

mia: +1 hold. need to confirm cache hit-rate not regressing and kv-store latency.

lara: agree. pausing auto-roll forward. I'll annotate release notes and set the flag to manual progression.

deploy-bot: auto-step paused by user. next step requires manual approval. to continue: `/ffctl approve model-routing-parity --next 50` or to rollback: `/ffctl rollback model-routing-parity`

sam: noted. i'll open a short follow-up in 25m with metric diffs.

alex: thanks all — no rollback for now, keeping pinned cohorts until green. will reconvene if 5xx > 0.3% or p95 > +200ms. :eyes:
